00024 /**
00025  * @brief Constants defining effects for image blitting.  These constants
00026  * can be combined.
00027  */
00028 typedef enum HxBlitFlags_t
00029 {
00030     /**
00031      * @brief Use none of the effects
00032      */
00033     kHxBlitNoFX             = 0,
00034 
00035     /**
00036      * @brief Enable alpha blending, using the alpha channel from source
00037      */
00038     kHxBlitBlendAlphaChannel = (1 << 0),
00039 
00040     /**
00041      * @brief Enable alpha blending, using the constant alpha value contained
00042      * within the widget's current color
00043      */
00044     kHxBlitBlendColorAlpha = (1 << 1),
00045 
00046     /**
00047      * @brief Modulate the source color with the widget's current color
00048      */
00049     kHxBlitColorize        = (1 << 2),
00050 
00051     /**
00052      * @brief Do not blit pixels matching the source color key
00053      */
00054     kHxBlitSrcColorKey     = (1 << 3),
00055 
00056     /**
00057      * @brief Write to the destination only if the destination pixel matches
00058      * the destination color key
00059      */
00060     kHxBlitDstColorKey     = (1 << 4),
00061 
00062     /**
00063      * @brief Modulate the source color with the (modulated) source alpha
00064      */
00065     kHxBlitSrcPremultiply  = (1 << 5),
00066 
00067     /**
00068      * @brief Modulate the destination color with the destination alpha
00069      */
00070     kHxBlitDstPremultiply  = (1 << 6),
00071 
00072     /**
00073      * @brief Divide the color by the alpha value before writing the data to
00074      * the destination
00075      */
00076     kHxBlitDemultiply      = (1 << 7),
00077 
00078     /**
00079      * @brief Deinterlace the source during blitting by reading only one field
00080      * (every second line of the full image), scaling it vertically
00081      */
00082     kHxBlitDeinterlace     = (1 << 8),
00083 
00084     kHxBlitFlagsMask       = kHxBlitBlendAlphaChannel | kHxBlitBlendColorAlpha
00085                               | kHxBlitColorize | kHxBlitSrcColorKey
00086                               | kHxBlitDstColorKey | kHxBlitSrcPremultiply
00087                               | kHxBlitDstPremultiply | kHxBlitDemultiply
00088                               | kHxBlitDeinterlace
00089 } HxBlitFlags_t;
